author: kevaundray
content: I think this is roughly what has been proposed but rounded up to the nearest powers of 2; blob retention 4096 (~18 days) and blocks 8192 (~36 days)

author: potuz
content: Cc <@543900561460822016> you used to be among the most worried about retaining history. What are the implications of only keeping 36 days worth of blocks by default

author: lightclient
content:
for me the worry ensuring the availability of historical blocks. although ere retrieval isn't perfect, the combo of having sources for those archives and the ability for nodes to communicate what history they have, i feel comfortable dropping some history (which we have been doing).

changing the retention window to me doesn't matter as much. so long as we have a safety margin over the WSC and keep unfinalized blocks, i think we shorten block history to 36 days. doubt there are many UX implications since 1) not so common to search for data that old 2) users can easily configure their window

author: kevaundray
content:
one thing I'm not sure about is CL block history

For blobs, I think the narrative is that rollups etc are incentivised to hold those, but is it the same re blocks

author: kevaundray
content: Ah my understanding was that so far we've only been talking about about retaining history for execution payloads/EL blocks, but we don't have something analogous for beacon chain blocks
